task: Structurally fix the merge ref problem: PRs report CONFLICTING while the same merge is clean locally, and a conflicting PR silently skips most CI while reporting green.

events.content: Confirmed the cause is that .gitattributes names a driver whose definition lives only in git config --local, which is never committed. 1 file changed the outcome.
No git built-in resolves this file correctly, so the custom driver cannot be swapped for a config-free equivalent. 5 cases tested.
The scheduled maintenance pipeline saw a phantom conflict on nearly every PR and spent model calls on a merge that has a deterministic driver. 2 files changed.
Runner-side merges now behave identically to a dev machine, proven by a negative control and a positive case on the same commit pair. 2 files changed.
Both findings were accurate and both are fixed. 2 files changed.
